patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Sudden-onset sensation of the room spinning

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: The patient is otherwise healthy with only a history of eczema. No prior episodes of similar nature.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies headaches, hearing loss, tinnitus, loss of consciousness or neurological deficits.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with sudden-onset symptoms of vertigo.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “I’m a 59-year-old man, and I came in because I suddenly felt like the room was spinning when I was going to bed. It lasted only about 3 minutes, and during it I had nausea and several episodes of vomiting, but I’m back to how I feel normally now.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin excoriations—like areas where the skin is scratched, rubbed raw, or has small open spots—anywhere on your body? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new skin excoriations, scratched or rubbed-raw areas, or small open spots anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you have pauses in breathing during sleep (for example, someone says you stop, or you wake up gasping)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been told that I stop breathing or have pauses during sleep, and I don’t wake up gasping. I also don’t recall any episodes like that.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, obvious swelling or deformity, trouble using the area, or pain that’s getting worse instead of better? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any injury or pain in a specific area—no severe pain, swelling, deformity, or worsening trouble using any part of my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No— I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist, and it doesn’t look red compared to the other side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the chest), especially after an injury, coughing, or vomiting?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall—no dark or discolored areas, even after the vomiting.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed urinating more than usual—no increased frequency or larger amounts lately. I haven’t had any urinary changes that stand out.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t used alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs, either currently or in the past.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble holding your urine—like leaking or needing to rush to the bathroom—so that you can’t make it in time? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any trouble holding my urine—no leaking, no rushing to the bathroom, and I can make it in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin spot, sore, or growth anywhere on your body? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin spots, sores, or growths anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even if they were mild or only happened once)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nosebleeds recently—nothing mild or even just once.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk—no rash on my chest, back, or belly.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in your legs (varicose veins), especially around the calves or ankles?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in my legs—no varicose veins around my calves or ankles.”
